content_of_post_to_comment: I barely post, and really don’t miss doomscrolling but I like to share my yearly 1-2 travels or life events with my not-too-close friends and family, just not to lose connection completely. It’s fun to share things and have a chat about it but I had to delete insta and facebook because of the flood of shit what’s there. Do you have any solution for maintaining a regular amount of social media or just take it or leave it?
comment: I’ve found the hardest part is that social apps are built around the feed, not the people you actually care about. I ended up treating them more like a photo album with occasional check-ins: upload something, reply to a few messages, then leave. A smaller circle or private group can sometimes keep the connection without inviting the endless scroll.
